_about: The recurring voices of HelloBuh's stories (docs/voices.md). A character keeps its id, Gemini voice AND direction string in every story: change one and it's a different person. scripts/tts.py reads `voice`, `name` (the speaker name Gemini sees), `profile` (the acting direction) and `post` (an ffmpeg filter run on every take, before loudness). `fallback` is a Kokoro-82M voice for when Gemini is out of quota (scripts/voice.py; tempo 1.0, rate 1.0: never the old 1.45x). `post` is EQ, or a tempo/formant-preserving rubberband shift for the narrator; never asetrate (docs/voices.md "Realism"). `color` is the character's caption colour (scripts/story_track.py; a story's cast `color` wins), matched to the character's look and role (owner, 2026-11-10: it should "match" the vibe of the character), with `color_why`; all of them read on the captions' dark outline and stay apart in pairs under red-green and blue-yellow colour blindness (docs/voices.md "Caption colours").

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.color_why: white: the narrator carries the story, so every other colour means someone else is talking
narrator.profile: Read this as a twelve-year-old boy telling his friends a funny story: quick, excited, mid-pitch, not squeaky; full volume, not whispery or breathy. Take a short breath between sentences.
narrator.from: Good Boy narrator audition, owner 2026-11-10: "kid puck is fine" (Leda was 'so high pitched and annoying'; wants a kid 'like the roblox shorts but more refined')
narrator.notes: No post filter, no tempo or pitch change. Measured ~235 Hz median on the audition (240-330 per line in a story), ~3.4 words/s while speaking. The short breath between sentences is what lets the splitter cut cleanly (voice_edges.py: 0 cut). No ellipses.
narrator.model_hint: single-speaker requests; gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview first, gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts on 429 (same voice)

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.color_why: pale lilac: a late-night story told close (white whenever she is the story's narrator)
storyteller.profile: the storyteller: a woman in her thirties telling a friend a story late at night, low and close, plain and conversational, never an announcer; she lets the strange detail land with a small pause before it
storyteller.notes: The old default narrator (Erinome until 2026-11-10, recast to Despina: Erinome was heard as 'announcer'/'audiobook' in three listening tests, Despina 9/10). Third-person framing for serious mystery stories; the default narrator is now the kid (`narrator`).

milo.name: Milo
milo.color_why: cyan: Steve's shirt (Milo is the default Steve skin)
milo.profile: Milo, our hero (played by the default Steve skin): a sixteen-year-old boy, friendly and quick, a little nervous; he jokes when he's scared, and goes quiet and serious when it matters
milo.from: the AI-dilemma voice for Claude, the trailer's Buh (renamed Milo, owner 2026-11-10) and the movie's brothers
milo.notes: First person. Range: scared/funny ('Okay. That's... not normal.'), serious, whispering. Never sped up.

elder.name: Elder
elder.color_why: warm amber: an old villager's brown-gold robe in lantern light
elder.profile: the village elder: an old man in his seventies, tired, low and a little rough in the throat, speaks slowly and quietly; he has seen this before, and that is what makes him unsettling
elder.from: the trailer's Highkeeper (Grok in the AI Shorts is the same voice, directed deep and heroic)
elder.notes: Librarian, grandfather, the one who knows the rule. Slow on purpose: give him short sentences. Recast Algenib -> Charon 2026-11-10 (realism test: Charon 'genuinely aged', Algenib 'sounds like a filter, younger than seventy').

child.name: Kid
child.color_why: sunny yellow: small, bright and quick
child.profile: a real village kid, about nine: small and quick, breath catching, words tumbling out a little too fast; scared but trying to be brave
child.notes: Recast Leda+2 st -> Laomedeia unshifted 2026-11-10: every listening test put the pitch lift last ('chipmunk', 'warble'); Laomedeia unshifted was heard as a real child. Never pitch-shift him.

smith.name: Smith
smith.color_why: iron grey: the anvil, and the iron golem he also voices
smith.profile: the blacksmith: a big, gruff man in his fifties, low and blunt, short sentences, no patience for nonsense, a soft heart he hides
smith.notes: Also the iron golem's voice if a golem ever talks (direct it slower, fewer words, and no post change).

stranger.name: Stranger
stranger.color_why: dusk violet: the hooded stranger at the edge of render distance, a little enderman
stranger.profile: a mysterious hooded stranger: very old and gravelly, a slow low whisper, knows a terrible secret and says less than he knows
stranger.notes: The wandering trader, the one at the edge of render distance. Keep his lines under ten words where possible. Voice moved Charon -> Algenib (gravelly) 2026-11-10 when Charon became the elder; audition him before his first story.

villain.name: Villain
villain.color_why: redstone red: the danger colour; the only red in the cast
villain.profile: the villain: a man in his forties, cold, flat and quiet, perfectly calm, never shouts, sounds faintly amused; the threat is in how polite he is
villain.notes: Herobrine-type, the thing in the fog, the one behind the twist. Calm beats loud: never direct him to yell.

mom.name: Mom
mom.color_why: warm peach: home, the hearth, the normal life before the strange thing
mom.profile: Milo's mom: a warm woman in her forties, gentle and tired, loving, calls from another room; a little worried under it
mom.notes: Home scenes, the normal life before the strange thing. Her ordinary line is often the scariest one in the twist.

friend.name: Max
friend.color_why: lime: loud, quick and loyal, all energy (a slime's green)
friend.profile: Milo's best friend: a sixteen-year-old boy, loud, excitable and loyal, talks fast, jokes, always up for it
friend.notes: The sidekick and comic relief; he goes first into the cave. Fenrir is brighter and faster than Milo's Achird, so the two read apart in an exchange.

_spares.Kore: crisp, firm woman (the AI Shorts' Gemini): a guard captain, an announcer, a cold official
_spares.Iapetus: measured, polite man (the AI Shorts' GPT): a mayor, a shopkeeper
_spares.Puck: cast as a 16-year-old boy in the trailer it read as a young woman: use it for a young woman; directed as an 11-year-old it read as 19 (kid audition)
_spares.Gacrux: mature woman: a grandmother, a witch
_spares.Enceladus: breathy man: a ghost, a sick villager
_spares.Erinome: clear, polished woman: heard as an announcer/audiobook reader; a radio host, a news voice, not a storyteller
_spares.Leda: unlifted: reads as a teenage girl of 15-18, very natural
_spares.Achernar: soft, very breathy woman: a ghost, someone sick

pip.name: Pip
pip.color_why: white: Pip is a narrator voice (a kid telling his own story)
pip.profile: A bubbly nine-year-old kid, fast, bright and energetic, telling a friend an amazing story; not whispery, breathy or soft
pip.from: Pip, Dog on the Hill voices v3 (owner 2026-11-10: 'i kinda like the pip here'; the 1.5x audition takes were 'too sped up')
pip.notes: Pip's voice (Dog on the Hill v3; owner: 'i kinda like the pip here', and again 'what about pip? i liked the audio i sent earlier'). Use for Pip and Pip-like young narrators when the story's kid is younger and sweeter; Puck (`narrator`) is the default. In Good Boy's take the same voice read 'so high pitched and annoying' (owner): keep the bubbly-nine-year-old direction and natural tempo, never a pitch lift.
pip.model_hint: gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts worked for Pip (single speaker, all narrator lines in one request, separated by blank lines, the profile as a short bracketed prefix); 3.1-flash-tts with the structured prompt is the default in tts.py
